biological_question: Do formerly unoccupied, historically stable nearby breeding-platform alternatives actually become used and persist after an unprecedented early-fast-ice-breakout disturbance? Distinguish habitat availability from realized colonization/rescue, dispersal limitation, and natal-site fidelity.
study_domain: Emperor penguin fast-ice breeding colonies, NOT strict terrestrial/offshore island sources, and no inferred individual migration.
prior_art_vetoes: Labrousse et al. 2023 already reported nonsignificant occupied vs unoccupied habitat contrasts and proposed intraspecific competition and empty potential refuge sites.
Fretwell et al. 2023/2024 already documented 2022 and 2023 widespread breeding failures.
Macdonald et al. 2026 already described three long-term calving responses.
Fretwell et al. 2026 already documented relocation of five emperor colonies, not transferable as an original finding.
Remote Sensing of Environment S0034425725003888 already analyzed short-range displacement of ten emperor colonies under storms/blizzards/low sea ice, 2013-2023.

pre_exposure.underlying_ice_maps: 2010–2018 (prior to 2022 shock), with 1km landfast-ice persistence and seasonal metrics
pre_exposure.exposure_caveat: A 2010–2018 historically stable candidate cell is NOT necessarily physical fast ice in 2022. Independently confirm contemporary passability BEFORE relocation.

post_exposure.observed_2022_failure_only: Fretwell et al 2023 and 2024 literature; 19/66 2022 and 14/66 2023 affected counts are already published and DO NOT equal colony disappearance.
post_exposure.additional_2024_2026: Not verified as a comparable exhaustive panel
post_exposure.data_coverage_caveat: 2022 region-specific record and 2023 circumpolar record are NOT matched annual panels by default; 2023 position accuracy ~2km, and its metadata progress says Planned.

predefined_spatial_neighborhoods.reason: Literature-informed correction before opening candidate 2022-2024 outcomes: the already-published Halley Bay→Dawson-Lambton reassignment crossed >40 km (55km as quoted in 2019; 85km in 2025; 62.1km great-circle from 2019 coordinates). A 40km primary radius mechanically excludes this positive-control event; use broad 100km eligibility and full continuous distance/path/access whenever data allow. Because this choice uses known prior art, do NOT use Halley as an independent holdout confirmation.
candidate_types: already occupied destination breeding colony: positive-control class, NOT previously unused refuge
repeatedly surveyed and unoccupied potential breeding patch with 2010–2018 high ice persistence and independently verified physical availability before the post-2022 move
unknown survey history/pseudoabsence: NOT eligible as known empty biological refuge
predefined_spatial_neighborhoods.distance_definition: WGS84 great-circle for screen; actual sea/ice route and cliff passability as independent covariates if mapped; named-study kilometers not equated with geodesic
predefined_spatial_neighborhoods.do_not_use_circular_exposure: Current colony position or guano signal must not define historic suitability or passability

eligible_unit: Named fixed colony network and austral breeding season, with unique source id, linked repeated imagery, and independently measured local access BEFORE location changes
primary_ecological_outcome: Documented use of previously unoccupied stable alternative AND continued verified breeding-season occupancy in next observed season (without equating this with individual fitness).
secondary_outcomes: confirmed colony disappearance with verified repeated negative surveys

key_nulls.H_option: Historically stable nearby unoccupied alternatives genuinely buffer relocation and subsequent site persistence when contemporaneously available.
key_nulls.H_fidelity: Even when alternatives remain available, most disturbed colonies return to natal/historical colony position; no detectable opportunity effect.
key_nulls.H_exposure: Local severity, timing of breakout, open-water access and current ice availability explain the spatial response, not historical available area.
key_nulls.H_detection: Lack of visible guano/colony is missed survey, fog, sensor or within-season shift; not biological disappearance.
key_nulls.H_competition: A positive selection of unoccupied stable patches could be competition release but cannot identify intra-specific competition without prior competitor pressure measured independently.

hard_stops: Historical model pseudoabsence cannot be treated as a surveyed vacant refuge: only independent sufficient-effort nonoccupancy qualifies for a novel 0→occupied biological test.
Dryad 55 baseline colony locations must first be crosswalked to independently verified stable IDs in the later 66-colony failure inventory; mismatched catalogue count is not ecological colonization.
No complete, detection-qualified 2022/2023 site×year colony identity crosswalk, especially for sites added to roster after 2018.
No independently observed contemporary 2022 alternative ice-area and route accessibility before purported relocation.
No actual movement or successive breeding evidence for most disturbed colonies; no pooling of child failure with adult colony disappearance.
Fewer than 10 independently identifiable relocation/persistence episodes with verified options: no confirmatory mechanism effect; descriptive only.
No matched regional forcing/exposure: no competition or option causality claim.
No future-data fit before header-only and source access results.
Do not score Halley→Dawson as a formerly vacant site: Dawson supported 1,280 counted breeding-pair equivalents in 2015; it is an established-colony receiving option.
Do not claim displaced individuals bred successfully merely because 2016/17 receiving-colony attendance increased; late-season unusual dispersed groups and uncertain reproduction.
All 100km neighborhood/known Halley positive-control comparisons are literature-informed model-development cases, not prospective independent confirmation.

known_published_summary.note: Aggregate prior art, NOT prospective response; do not use as site-level labels or 33 independent extinctions.

prepublished_positive_control.site_class: ALREADY_OCCUPIED_2015; emphatically NOT a formerly empty refuge
prepublished_positive_control.breeding_evidence_2016_17: dispersed crowds; many may have been nonbreeders
prepublished_positive_control.breeding_evidence_2018: dense aggregations and guano staining consistent with prolonged colony occupancy; not individual recruitment accounting
prepublished_positive_control.preexposed_novelty_limit: Halley→Dawson source relocation and the ~11-fold receiver census gain are established since Fretwell & Trathan 2019 and cannot be claimed as new.
